dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge following a parabolic spline from the posterior insertion point to the apex, characteristic of a falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a smooth curvature and a medium-width pixel radius, lacking any acute or jagged terminal points.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Smoothly convex anterior margin rising at an approximate 40-45 degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The total visible horizontal base of the dorsal region is approximately 3.2 times the vertical pixel height of the fin's apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple high-luminance punctate markings and small white depigmented patches are visible across the lateral surface of the fin and the dorsal ridge.
